name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: AI Product Builder & Systems Architect
summary: Builder and systems architect with 15+ years translating ambiguous business and customer intent into shipped products and services. Architects AI-driven agent systems and automation products end to end for B2B clients at Solenzo, from requirements through design, launch, and iteration. Took a brand-new product line from proof of concept to a profitable business at Wix, building the team's confidence and shipping through genuine ambiguity. Moves fast between strategic thinking and hands-on execution, then iterates based on real customer feedback.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.
Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for service-based businesses, primarily on GoHighLevel, automating lead enrichment, outreach, and appointment booking.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.
Configure and evaluate AI-generated response output for client automation systems, building rubric-based grading criteria and performing the underlying data labeling to keep outputs on standard.
Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system — 20+ workflows — spanning lead capture, qualification, appointment booking, no-show recovery, and lifecycle nurture.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, coordinating campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires and developing sales training for tenured account executives. (Corroborated by direct manager's written LinkedIn recommendation.)
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years — a team of 20, later a team of 8 — overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria for the team building it.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
